<!--
The GitHub release body for GeoTools 0.3.1 (and its 0.3.1-* prereleases).
scripts/release_notes.py prints this page with {version} replaced by the
version being released, then a link to the full changelog. Links are absolute
because a release body cannot follow relative links.
-->

GeoTools {version} fixes two wrong results that Blender 5.3 brings out. If
you use GeoTools in Blender 5.3, update: with 0.3.0 there, the texture tools
miss texels and Distance to Surface can give 0. In Blender 5.2 the update is
safe and rarely changes a result.

## What is fixed

- **Texture tools and the UV overlap check on shared edges.** Blender 5.3
  runs Python with very small numbers rounded to zero, and GeoTools relied on
  one of them. Fill Holes, the paint setup's overlap mask and the UV overlap
  check then left out the texels that lie exactly on an edge shared by two
  triangles, such as the diagonal of every quad. They are counted again.
- **Distance to Surface could give 0.** For a point in the plane of the
  reference face it was signed by, at a sharp edge, the distance came out as
  0 instead of its value. Blender 5.3 picks such faces more often. The preset
  is now version 2. An analysis you added before keeps the old node group:
  remove its modifier and add Distance to Surface again to get the fix.

GeoTools is now tested on Blender 5.2.0, 5.2 LTS and 5.3.0 for every change.

## Download

Download the zip for your platform. Each one holds everything GeoTools needs
(rusty-tiles, pyproj with PROJ, and certifi); there is nothing to install with
pip.

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Linux x64 | [`geotools-{version}-linux_x64.zip`](https://github.com/BenDyson-Arch/blender_geotools/releases/download/v{version}/geotools-{version}-linux_x64.zip) |
| Windows x64 | [`geotools-{version}-windows_x64.zip`](https://github.com/BenDyson-Arch/blender_geotools/releases/download/v{version}/geotools-{version}-windows_x64.zip) |
| macOS, Apple silicon | [`geotools-{version}-macos_arm64.zip`](https://github.com/BenDyson-Arch/blender_geotools/releases/download/v{version}/geotools-{version}-macos_arm64.zip) |

**Do not install "Source code (zip)" or "Source code (tar.gz)".** They are
the repository's source, without the bundled libraries, and Blender cannot
install them as an extension.

## Install

1. In Blender, open **Edit > Preferences > Get Extensions**, open the menu at
   the top right and choose **Install from Disk...**, then pick the zip.
2. **Restart Blender** if an older GeoTools was installed. Until you do, the
   running session keeps the old bundled libraries, whose files the update
   replaced, and pyproj can fail every CRS lookup with a PROJ "disk I/O
   error" ([#134](https://github.com/BenDyson-Arch/blender_geotools/issues/134)).
3. Open the **About** panel at the bottom of the **GeoTools** tab. It should
   show GeoTools {version}, and a tick when rusty-tiles and pyproj both
   loaded.

The requirements are those of 0.3.0: an official Blender 5.2 or later from
[blender.org](https://www.blender.org/download/) (CPython 3.13), on Linux x64,
Windows x64, or macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon. `SHA256SUMS` lists the
SHA-256 of every zip in this release.
